check_box.name: web_proxy_enabled
check_box.label: Use HTTP Proxy for Web pages

line_editor.name: web_proxy_editor
line_editor.tool_tip: The DNS name or IP address of the HTTP proxy you would like to use.

spinner.name: web_proxy_port
spinner.label: Port number:
spinner.tool_tip: The port of the HTTP proxy you would like to use.

check_box.name: socks_proxy_enabled
check_box.label: Use SOCKS 5 Proxy for UDP traffic

line_editor.name: socks_proxy_editor
line_editor.tool_tip: The DNS name or IP address of the SOCKS 5 proxy you would like to use.

spinner.name: socks_proxy_port
spinner.label: Port number:
spinner.tool_tip: The port of the SOCKS 5 proxy you would like to use.

line_editor.name: socks5_username
line_editor.tool_tip: The username used to authenticate with your SOCKS 5 server

line_editor.name: socks5_password
line_editor.tool_tip: The password used to authenticate with your SOCKS 5 server

radio_item.name: OtherNoProxy
radio_item.label: Do not proxy
radio_item.tool_tip: Non-web HTTP traffic will NOT be sent to any proxy.

radio_item.name: OtherHTTPProxy
radio_item.label: Use HTTP Proxy
radio_item.tool_tip: Non-web HTTP will be sent through the configured Web proxy.

radio_item.name: OtherSocksProxy
radio_item.label: Use SOCKS 5 Proxy
radio_item.tool_tip: Non-web HTTP traffic will be sent through the configured Socks 5 proxy.
